unit: Whole source-indexed paper: every original results row for each selected arxiv_id is retained. Shared PDF endpoints across those rows are counted once.
eligibility: A paper is eligible only when every original indexed pair and every endpoint pass completed-anonymization checks. Papers with any uncompleted indexed pair are excluded entirely.
allocation: Hamilton PDF-version targets proportional to each source's indexed completed-version population; actual counts use the nearest whole-paper ranked prefix per source, with inclusion on equal distance.
ranking: Whole-paper review tier first, then SHA256(seed + NUL + source + NUL + arxiv_id). No paper is split or lower-ranked paper substituted merely to hit500.

review_tiers.0: Every included version has all9 current model/condition cells published
review_tiers.1: Every included version has all3 GPT-5.5 conditions published
review_tiers.2: Every included version has some published review
review_tiers.3: Some included versions have a published review
review_tiers.4: No included version has a published review

coverage_provenance.normalization: Exact authorized remote project-root prefix is removed from absolute PDF paths; provided project-relative paths must agree.
coverage_provenance.binding_limit: Anonymous PDF hashes are from the frozen accepted review scope; no new full-PDF byte audit for this metadata sample.

provenance.binding_method: Exact source/arxiv/version/canonical anonymous-relative-path and anonymization-receipt-path equality against frozen review scope, plus frozen anonymousPDF SHA and verified published leaf/receipt links. canonical_index_sha256 identifies the fresh metadata joined here, not an invented field in the review scope.
provenance.limits: No PDF bytes rehashed/transferred. Frozen scope has no direct canonical-index hash field; existing input/receipt/native-report hashes retained. No experiment actions.

limitations: All original indexed pairs are included; no unindexed version combinations are invented.
The existing index's canonical completion metadata and frozen PDF bindings are reused; this is not a new PDF-content audit.
Review priority intentionally biases the sample. Approximate500 is a scale target, not permission to truncate a paper.
No anonymization/review/model jobs or paused campaigns are resumed.
